tex_content.html:
Lemma
[an orthonormal basis for the metric at a point]

Let $g$ be a Riemannian metric on $M$ and $q\in M$. Then $T_qM$ has an orthonormal basis for $\langle \cdot ,\cdot \rangle _q$.
Proof

\sketch $\langle \cdot ,\cdot \rangle _q$ is a symmetric bilinear form on the finite-dimensional space $T_qM$, positive definite by the definition of a Riemannian metric. Diagonalize it and normalize.

□
